## Relational databases

Where is the manual for this relational database?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [PostgreSQL Documentation](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/) | PostgreSQL Global Development Group | Entry page to the PostgreSQL manuals: versions 15 through 19 online and as PDF, a development snapshot, translated manuals, and an archive of older versions. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [MariaDB Documentation](https://mariadb.com/docs/) | MariaDB | MariaDB's documentation for the Community and Enterprise servers: a guide from install to first query, then paths for developing, analytics, migrating, deploying, and production. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [SQL Server technical documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/sql-server/) | Microsoft | Microsoft's documentation hub for SQL Server: what's new, quickstarts, downloads and deployment, database design, querying, business intelligence, and reference, with links to Azure SQL. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Oracle AI Database Documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/) | Oracle | Oracle's documentation library for its database, by release from 26ai back to 11g: getting started, what's new, and books on administration, development, installation, and security. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [SQLite Documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/docs.html) | SQLite | Index of SQLite's documentation: overview documents, SQL syntax, pragmas and functions, the C/C++ interface, the CLI, and lists of every document by title and keyword. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [PostgreSQL wiki](https://wiki.postgresql.org/wiki/Main_Page) | PostgreSQL Global Development Group | Community wiki for PostgreSQL: FAQs, guides and tutorials, code snippets, installation guides, advice on converting from other databases, and a working area for contributors. | Reference | Free |

## Administration and tuning tools

What helps me back up, tune, and look after a database?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [pgAdmin](https://www.pgadmin.org/) | pgAdmin Development Team | Open source management tool for PostgreSQL that runs as a desktop or web application, with graphical object management and a query tool with graphical EXPLAIN. | Tool | Free |
| [DBeaver Community](https://dbeaver.io/) | DBeaver Corp | Open source edition of the DBeaver database tool: data and SQL editors for relational databases; the commercial DBeaver PRO adds NoSQL and cloud databases. | Tool | Freemium |
| [SQL Server Management Studio documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ssms/) | Microsoft | Microsoft's SQL Server Management Studio documentation: what SSMS is, download and installation, release notes, a connect-and-query quickstart, customization, and troubleshooting. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [dbatools](https://dbatools.io/) | dbatools | Commands for running SQL Server from PowerShell: migrating instances, exporting configurations, testing that backups restore, setting up log shipping, and patching; free and open source. | Tool | Free |
| [SQL Server Maintenance Solution](https://ola.hallengren.com/) | Ola Hallengren | Free stored-procedure scripts for SQL Server upkeep: backups, with S3 and Azure Blob Storage among the targets, database integrity checks, index rebuilds, and statistics updates. | Tool | Free |
| [SQL Server First Responder Kit](https://github.com/BrentOzarULTD/SQL-Server-First-Responder-Kit) | Brent Ozar Unlimited | Brent Ozar Unlimited's stored procedures for diagnosing SQL Server: sp_Blitz for overall health, sp_BlitzCache for resource-heavy queries, sp_BlitzIndex for index tuning, and sp_BlitzLock for deadlocks. | Tool | Free |
| [pgBackRest](https://pgbackrest.org/) | PostgreSQL Global Development Group | PostgreSQL backup tool with parallel processing, lz4 and zstd compression, local or remote operation, multiple repositories, and backup from a standby; MIT licensed. | Tool | Free |
| [Barman](https://pgbarman.org/) | EnterpriseDB | EnterpriseDB's backup and recovery manager for PostgreSQL: point-in-time recovery, remote management of many servers centrally, and a catalogue of each server's backups. | Tool | Free |
| [Percona Toolkit Documentation](https://docs.percona.com/percona-toolkit/) | Percona LLC | Documentation for Percona Toolkit: an installation guide, configuration, and a page for each tool, among them pt-query-digest, pt-online-schema-change, and pt-table-checksum, for MySQL and MongoDB work. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [PgBouncer](https://www.pgbouncer.org/) | PgBouncer Authors | Home of PgBouncer, a pooler for PostgreSQL connections that is light on resources: release news including security fixes, and documentation for installation, configuration, and usage. | Tool | Free |
| [PGTune](https://pgtune.leopard.in.ua/) | PGTune | Web form that suggests PostgreSQL configuration settings from your version, operating system, workload type, memory, CPUs, and storage; a starting point, its about page says. | Online service | Free |
| [explain.depesz.com](https://explain.depesz.com/) | Hubert Lubaczewski (depesz) and Łukasz Lewandowski (metys) | Paste the output of PostgreSQL's EXPLAIN ANALYZE and get it back as a readable table; plans can stay off the history page or be obfuscated. | Online service | Free |
| [explain.dalibo.com](https://explain.dalibo.com/) | Dalibo | Dalibo's visualizer for PostgreSQL execution plans: paste a plan as text or JSON, with the query if you like; a standalone HTML version runs locally. | Online service | Free |
| [MySQLTuner](https://github.com/major/MySQLTuner-perl) | Major Hayden (major) | Perl script that inspects a MySQL, MariaDB, or Percona Server and reports its settings and status with tuning advice, drawing on some 900 indicators. | Tool | Free |
| [Patroni documentation](https://patroni.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) | Compose, Zalando SE, Patroni Contributors | Documentation for Patroni, a template for highly available PostgreSQL using ZooKeeper, etcd, or Consul: installation, configuration, the REST API, patronictl, replication modes, and Kubernetes. | Vendor documentation | Free |

## Learning and community

Where do I learn SQL and database practice, and who can I ask?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Use The Index, Luke](https://use-the-index-luke.com/) | Markus Winand | Free web edition of Markus Winand's book on SQL indexing: how an index is built, the where clause, and more, across the major databases. | Reference | Free |
| [Database Administrators Stack Exchange](https://dba.stackexchange.com/) | Stack Exchange Inc | Stack Exchange's question-and-answer site on database administration, with questions tagged by product and topic such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, replication, and performance. | Community | Free |
| [Planet PostgreSQL](https://planet.postgresql.org/) | PostgreSQL Global Development Group | Aggregator of blog posts about PostgreSQL from across its community, newest first, each with its author, source, and date. | News | Free |
| [Brent Ozar Unlimited blog](https://www.brentozar.com/blog/) | Brent Ozar Unlimited | Brent Ozar's blog on running SQL Server: performance posts, Office Hours videos, opinion, and news of the training classes the company sells. | News | Free |
| [SQL Style Guide](https://www.sqlstyle.guide/) | Simon Holywell | Style guide for writing SQL: naming conventions for tables and columns, query syntax and white space, create syntax, data types, and designs to avoid. | Reference | Free |
| [PostgreSQL Exercises](https://pgexercises.com/) | Alisdair Owens | SQL exercises with explanations, all on one simple dataset: basics, aggregates, joins and subqueries, dates, strings, modifying data, and recursive queries. | Training or lab | Free |
| [SQLBolt](https://sqlbolt.com/) | SQLBolt | Interactive SQL lessons in the browser, each ending in an exercise: SELECT queries, filtering and sorting, joins, aggregates, then changing tables and creating new ones. | Training or lab | Free |
| [Jepsen analyses](https://jepsen.io/analyses) | Jepsen, LLC | Jepsen's published analyses of how databases, queues, and coordination services behave in practice, listed by system, date, and version tested, with its ethics policy. | Research blog | Free |
